dct_description_sm: California's insularity indefinite; Cap Blanc de S. Sebastien is labelled at its north end, but coastline entends north and small islands are to its east.
Paragraphs of text within title cartouche and covering ocean areas.
Title within oval held by figure of 'America' (bottom left). A ribbon of 27 medallions, mostly portraits of explorers, runs down left side of map.
